html:
Safety glass film is an ideal choice for both residential and commercial buildings.

Below, find out why so many people are choosing our safety glass film for windows in their homes and offices.

Tint a Home is Australia’s most trusted tinting network for car, home and office window tinting.

We have been providing tinting services in Australia for over 42 years, offer a lifetime warranty on most of our films which are exclusive to us and are Government-certified by ARPANSA to ensure the highest quality.

If you want to make your home or office safer and secure, here is why our safety and security window films are a great choice

Safety And Security Window Film

Safety glass film for windows gives you peace of mind that if the glass is broken, injury is minimised as the film is designed to hold shattered glass together.

Because it is thicker than the standard film it strengthens your windows so is also ideal in places where severe weather is a risk factor.

Your family will be kept safe in the event of an accident if children are playing near windows and it also helps to prevent break-ins too as it makes gaining access to your home harder.

You can also use our safety film for glass shower doors and other internal glass areas too to make internal glass areas safer.

Our security film is 10 times thicker than standard film so if hit with force, glass is harder to break and if broken, it will keep shattered glass together.

Security film is ideal for office spaces where there is expensive equipment, especially if visible from the outside.

Many people choose to use safety and security window film at entry points to their home or office such as front/back doors, sliding doors and any other high traffic areas or areas that may be susceptible to break-ins.

All our safety and security window film is installed by professionally trained installers.

Depending on the safety and security window film you choose, other benefits can include:

  • Protection from harmful UV rays
  • A reduction in heat & glare (much more comfortable year-round temperatures…. which you’ll notice on your power bills)
  • Added privacy with our reflective films
  • Prevention of premature fading of furniture, furnishings and flooring
